title: 诺和诺德CEO：减重药盈利将持续改善，成本优化与产能效率双驱动
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Do you expect profitability on the pill to improve in the course of the year?
segments.zh: 您是否预期这种承压的盈利能力在今年内会有所提升？

segments.en: As people, of course, are titrating into the higher dosage of the pill, there is no secret that the price of the higher dosage or higher, so that, of course, improves the
segments.zh: 随着人们逐渐增加承压的剂量，高剂量的价格更高，这自然会提高盈利能力。

segments.en: profitability even for the sickle patient that's on the pill today.
segments.zh: 即使是目前服用这种承压的患者，也能从中受益。

segments.en: As we are, of course, also going forward, we continue to create efficiencies in our manufacturing sites and in our cost structure, that is also improving it.
segments.zh: 同时，我们也在持续提高生产效率，优化成本结构，这也有助于提升盈利能力。

segments.en: In general, I would say the profitability of the pill is decent and will continue to get better.
segments.zh: 总的来说，这种承压的盈利能力不错，而且会继续改善。

segments.en: If that was not the case, we would not be launching the product in more and more markets.
segments.zh: 如果不是这样，我们就不会在越来越多的市场推出该产品。

segments.en: We have just announced, of course, that we will continue post-U.K. and UAE our launch into Germany and more to come, so that is, of course, on the back of seeing the top and
segments.zh: 我们刚刚宣布，继英国和阿联酋之后，将继续在德国推出，未来还会有更多市场。

segments.en: the bottom line of the pill in our performance.
segments.zh: 这得益于该承压在我们的业绩中表现出的收入和利润。
